name: Sendinblue Website Clone
headline: Sendinblue Website Clone: Marketing Platform
short_description: It is a Sendinblue website clone. Basically, it is a digital marketing platform that provides some marketing tools to grow business online. Tools are Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, Automation, etc. I have cloned some features from it like the signup and login feature, homepage, email feature, etc.
author: er-priyanka

sections.overview:
This Sendinblue website clone is a digital marketing platform built with React that provides essential tools to grow businesses online. It replicates core features including user authentication (signup and login), email marketing capabilities, SMS marketing, and automation workflows. The platform demonstrates a complete marketing solution frontend with routing and user management. Ideal for learning how modern marketing platforms are structured or as a foundation for building custom marketing tools.
Learning React frontend architecture for marketing platforms
Building email marketing campaign interfaces
Implementing user authentication and account management
Creating SMS marketing automation workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/er-priyanka/sendinblue-website-clone`
sections.usage:
```
Create a Sendinblue-style digital marketing platform website clone for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. Include the following features: a signup/login page, homepage with key marketing tools like Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, and Automation. Use [COLOR_SCHEME] and [LOGO] for branding. Ensure the design is clean, modern, and mobile-responsive.
```
